item.title: Four years after planning group reform: Communities still have power, if they work for it
item.description: It’s a time of shifting sands for the 42 community planning groups that are the official voice of San Diego neighborhoods when it comes to land-use decisions. This is in part due to reforms passed in 2022, but also because of dramatic changes to local and statewide housing rules and regulations. The city’s Complete Communities […]

item.title: Man reportedly shoots himself as police try to take him into custody
item.description: The man was reportedly sitting inside a parked car in the 5000 block of Newport Avenue when police contacted him.

item.title: San Diego Humane Society advises community on living alongside coyotes
item.description: San Diego Humane Society is marking Coyote Awareness Week by encouraging residents to better understand the role coyotes play in the region’s ecosystem and to take steps to safely coexist with them.

item.title: Cómo la venta de una propiedad reveló errores de zonificación en Barrio Logan
item.description: Los planificadores urbanos de San Diego dejaron por error el Parque Chicano y otra propiedad en Barrio Logan zonificadas para uso comercial, a pesar de que un plan comunitario las designaba como parques.

item.title: Border Patrol’s Greg Bovino expected to retire from El Centro post, CBS News reports
item.description: Controversial Border Patrol official Greg Bovino is expected to retire from federal service at the end of the month after being relieved of his national leadership role in January and returning to his former post in El Centro, neighboring San Diego County, sources told CBS News Monday.

item.title: La Policía intensifica la represión contra la vivienda en vehículos recreativos (RV)
item.description: El número de multas impuestas en virtud de la ordenanza municipal sobre vehículos de gran tamaño se ha duplicado con creces desde que comenzó la campaña contra la vida en vehículos recreativos en julio.

item.title: First CalFresh, Medi-Cal eligibility changes take effect April 1
item.description: Federal and state policy updates over the next several months may affect thousands of San Diego County residents who receive CalFresh or Medi-Cal benefits.

item.title: San Diego County faces dangerous heat this week, desert highs could reach 112
item.description: Scorching heat will retain a grip on parts of San Diego County through Saturday, forecasters said Monday.

item.title: SD Wave reportedly sign USWNT star Macario to historic contract
item.description: The San Diego Wave signed USWNT star Catarina Macario to a contract believed to be the biggest in the history of women's soccer.

item.title: San Diego to host 11 LA28 Olympic soccer matches, most of any city
item.description: San Diego will host Olympic soccer matches in 2028, LA28 officials announced Monday, as the deadline to register for the ticket draw approaches.
